core_obligations: Use the strong success-rate condition to convert relaxed insdel decoding into ordinary local decoding.
Track the query/advantage/error parameters and derive the stated exponential code length restriction.
difficulty_reason: Establishes a reduction from strong relaxed insertion-deletion decoding to a standard local-decoding setting and applies the insdel lower-bound machinery. Nonadaptivity, query complexity, error tolerance and success-rate parameters are preserved.
